FULL TEXT:
SCHOOL OF PUNJABI STUDIES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
NOTICE
Applications are invited for two (02) posts of Guest Faculty in Punjabi. Applications
complete in all respects (please refer to : https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf) along with a
recent passport size photograph, copies of degrees, certificates of merit, awards (scholarships /
fellowships), lists of publications and other supporting documents must reach the Department
office by 16.07.2024 before 5:00 PM by post or by email (head_pbi@pu.ac.in )
No. of Posts: 02 (TWO)
Essential
Qualifications
: 1. M.A. in Punjabi with good academic record as defined by the
concerned University with at least 55% marks (50% for
SC/ST/Physically & Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade in
a point scale wherever grading system is followed at the Master’s
degree level in a relevant subject from an Indian University, or an
equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
2. UGC NET
3. Ph.D. in the relevant subject (Punjabi)
Note: i) Candidates, who have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the
University Grants Commission (Minimum standard and Procedure for Award of Ph.D.
Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET.
ii) The appointment shall be made as per University Grants Commission Regulation, 2018.
(UNIVERSITY GRANTS COMMISSION NOTIFICATION, New Delhi -18th July,
2018)
iii) The superannuated teachers may also be considered for engagement as Guest Faculty
subject to a maximum age limit of 70 years and approval of the competent authority.
iv) The above assignment will be on lecture basis with an honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.
vi) The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he / she will not draw any
fellowship/ stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till he / she is teaching
in the Department of Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Sd/-
Chairperson
